description: MENA - Electricity Transmission Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Main nodes and major lines of the electricity transmission network of the MENA region. Interconnection lines with countries outside of the region included. The properties for nodes are "name" and "node type" (city, town, plant, dam...). The properties for lines are the "transmission power" in kV (e.g. Coverage: 14 countries in the Middle East and North Africa. It has 1 file in JSON. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
